text:
Type: long wooden TV bench with drawers
Use: holding a TV and media devices, storing games and remotes; living room, family room
Style: farmhouse, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: solid wood with a white stain that shows the grain, dark round metal knobs
Colors: soft white, dark grey knobs
Shape: long low cabinet with three open cubbies above three drawers, small round knobs, overhanging flat top, framed side panels, short square legs, sturdy and wide, medium visual weight
Feel: fresh, homey, calm, classic
Goes with: light wood floors, linen textiles, blue or grey walls; farmhouse, country or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Solid wood has a natural feel.
